text:
maria: Quick heads-up — the new per-route sampling toggle in Console is flipping telemetry sampling but looks like it's also changing quota enforcement for service accounts. Anyone else seeing this?
kevin: saw it. repro: enable sampling on route `ingest/v1` -> some SA calls started getting 429s. :thinking:
sasha: hmm, can you paste the API payload the Console is sending?
maria: sure — from network tab: ```{
  "route_id": "ingest/v1",
  "telemetry_sampling": 0.1
}```
arun: aha. backend code expects `sampling_rate` not `telemetry_sampling`. when missing we default to 0 which disables quota-exempt path and triggers quota checks.
kevin: that explains it. so two bugs: UI field name mismatch and default behavior coupling sampling -> quota enforcement.
ellie: proposed fix: UI should send both keys for backward compat, and backend should treat missing as no-change rather than 0. low-risk patch?
kevin: agree. also add a feature-flag rollout for the Console change. we should avoid flipping it for all tenants at once.
maria: +1. i'll file a tiny PR to add `sampling_rate` in payload and flag behind `per_route_sampling_v2`.
sasha: telemetry note: we need to ensure sampling doesn't remove tenant-level telemetry labels used for cost attribution. add test that verifies `tenant_id` remains in sampled events.
arun: backend checklist: 1) accept `telemetry_sampling` and `sampling_rate` 2) when field omitted, preserve existing sampling config 3) do not treat 0 as 'disable quota-exempt' 4) write migration log entry for routes updated by Console.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: route-sampling-service v2 -> staging at 2024-11-02T15:12:30Z :rocket:
maria: i'll also add a small note in Console UX: "Changing sampling will not change quota rules" to avoid surprises.
ellie: can we add a quick integration test that simulates SA token requests with sampling toggled? prefer in e2e to catch regressions.
kevin: i'll take e2e. ETA tomorrow.
sasha: ping @arun when PR is ready for review — want to sanity-check the defaulting logic.
arun: will do. thanks all. :thumbsup:
